description: What PlanningLedger can answer for a council: where search across documents is open, council by council and year by year (the search gate). A council's application year opens when at least 90% of its decision documents (decision notices and officer reports) are searchable, and closes again only below 85%. The share counts against the documents the council's portal lists for that year; a decided application we have not captured counts as missing. Give a council (slug, GSS code or name) for its last ten years, newest first, each with documents listed and searchable, uncaptured applications, share, open or closed and when it opened, plus a one-line summary; add `year` for one year. Omit the council for the national count of open council-years (add `by_council: true` for every council's open years). Check this before saying a search found nothing: a closed year is not yet searchable here, which is not the same as no results. Only search across documents is gated: `also_answered` lists what the other tools answer for the council whatever the year (its applications, one application's documents and quotes, decision counts, appeals, Local Plan policies). Measured nightly over every document; a reading older than 48 hours is refused (503). An unknown council is 400 unknown_council with suggestions.

council.description: The council: a council slug (e.g. 'camden', 'leeds-city-council'), its name (e.g. 'Leeds', 'London Borough of Camden') or its GSS code (e.g. 'E08000035'); an unknown or misspelt council is a 400 unknown_council error listing suggestions, and a region such as 'London' is a 400 region_not_council error listing its councils. Omit for the national count of open council-years.
council.title: Council

year.description: One application year (by valid or received date). Omit for all ten measured years.
year.title: Year
